name: Tool Usage Pattern Analyzer
description: Analyzes patterns in tool usage to identify inefficiencies
promptTemplate:
Analyze the tool usage patterns from these {{events.length}} tool calls:

{{events}}

Provide insights on:
1. Most frequently used tools
2. Average execution time by tool
3. Success/failure rates
4. Patterns of inefficient tool usage (e.g., repeated similar calls)
5. Suggestions for optimization
